strength.label: Published equipment
strength.text: The SR offer lists dual-channel ABS, reverse and tyre-pressure monitoring.

tradeoff.label: Charging equipment
tradeoff.text: The SR offer includes a 1.85 kW onboard charger, but a compatible charging cable/mobile connector is not included.

conditions: Named Australian advertised New offer only; manufacturer model year, exact component-level factory build, allocated unit/VIN, physical stock, accepted individual order and buyer delivery remain unverified.

AUD 10,290 is the exact observed Forza Aranciata / Black vegan vehicle amount, taxes included, with local registration/stamp duty/third-party insurance at Sydney HQ. Dealer delivery and freight are excluded; not a national delivered quote or verified deposit charge.

SR standard single-pack and LR advertised dual-pack architectures are supported at offer/family level. LR “Max capacity: Option 7.56kWh (2* 3.78kWh)” is optional maximum context, not proven selected standard energy. Exact pack SKU, nominal/rated/gross/usable energy, voltage, mass and cell subtype remain unknown. No Arthur battery data or halving of the LR option supplies SR capacity.

SR sale explicitly calls 10.7 kW peak; LR sale says 10.7 kW without a basis; Z specs say 11.0 kW output without a comparable basis. Preserve every label, do not reconcile or infer rated/continuous output.

SR sale up to 100 km urban / 75 km mixed differs from overview 100/70 and 100/80/60 mode claims. LR sale 180 km with extender differs in context from overview 180/120 and 180/130/100 modes. No formal test cycle or comparison/ranking-eligible range is established.

Included onboard charger is advertised as 1.85 kW / 25 A; the current basis is unstated. Charging cable/mobile connector is excluded. External-charger inclusion and SKU are not established. Single-Powerpack roughly one-hour-to-80% wording has unspecified starting SOC and is not whole-LR timing. Manual SR/LR Type 2 and indoor Higo tables have no stated SOC endpoints. Generic Z support SOC times lack pack-count binding and do not override the manual. No DC capability/rate is established; three-phase incompatibility alone does not prove DC absence.

Selected sales advertise 36 months/20,000 km; Z manual lists components for manufacturer error and retains a stray Arthu fragment. Current linked full policy effective 1 January 2024 names Arthur 6/NKD, not Z. Earlier-of-time/distance and separate unspecified external-charger/accessory cover remain linked-policy context. Exact applicable Z full-policy revision, retained-capacity threshold and external-charger warranty duration remain unknown.

S.E. Electric Blue is separately observed MY26 package context, with its own product/variant and cosmetic/accessory claims. It remains a qualified existing market name only; no third detailed candidate. Its MY26, immediate delivery, included topcase/backrest, price and energy do not flow to SR/LR.
Published exact-offer features; no independently inspected unit or final build fitment verification.
